# Acme Services Agreement

Effective date: 2026-05-20

Acme Robotics signs a pilot agreement with Northstar Labs for the Chief OS
platform evaluation.

## Commercial terms

- Northstar Labs will deliver the pilot workspace by 2026-06-03.
- Acme will provide a security contact before kickoff.
- Payment terms are Net 60 after invoice receipt.
- Either party may terminate the pilot with 14 days written notice.

## Follow-up requirement

Northstar Labs should send Acme a written follow-up confirming the kickoff date,
the security contact request, and the payment-term risk.
